import Mathlib

namespace InvariantIntertwiners

theorem matrix_unit_product {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (i j k l : I) :
    Matrix.single i j (1 : ℂ) * Matrix.single k l 1 =
      if j = k then Matrix.single i l 1 else 0 := by
  by_cases h : j = k
  · subst k
    simp
  · simpa [h] using
      (Matrix.single_mul_single_of_ne i j k h (1 : ℂ) :
        Matrix.single i j (1 : ℂ) * Matrix.single k l 1 = 0)

theorem normalized_matrix_unit_trace {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (i j : I) :
    Matrix.trace (Matrix.single i j (1 : ℂ)) / (Fintype.card I : ℂ) =
      if i = j then 1 / (Fintype.card I : ℂ) else 0 := by
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst j
    simp
  · simp [h, Matrix.trace_single_eq_of_ne i j (1 : ℂ) h]

theorem probe_successor_unique {S I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (embed : S → I) (hembed : Function.Injective embed)
    (p q : Equiv.Perm S)
    (hproduct : ∀ i,
      Matrix.single (embed i) (embed (p i)) (1 : ℂ) *
        Matrix.single (embed (q i)) (embed (p (q i))) 1 ≠ 0) :
    p = q := by
  ext i
  apply hembed
  by_contra h
  apply hproduct i
  rw [matrix_unit_product, if_neg h]

theorem cycle_lengths_forced {t n r : ℕ} (lengths : Fin t → ℕ)
    (hroot : 1 ≤ r) (htails : ∀ i, 2 ≤ lengths i)
    (htotal : r + ∑ i, lengths i = n + 1)
    (hthreshold : n + 2 ≤ 2 * (t + 1)) :
    r = 1 ∧ ∀ i, lengths i = 2 := by
  have hsum : 2 * t ≤ ∑ i, lengths i := by
    calc
      2 * t = ∑ _i : Fin t, 2 := by simp [Nat.mul_comm]
      _ ≤ ∑ i, lengths i := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => htails i
  have hr : r = 1 := by omega
  have hs : ∑ i, lengths i = 2 * t := by omega
  have hexpand :
      ∑ i, lengths i = (∑ i, (lengths i - 2)) + 2 * t := by
    calc
      ∑ i, lengths i = ∑ i, ((lengths i - 2) + 2) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        exact (Nat.sub_add_cancel (htails i)).symm
      _ = (∑ i, (lengths i - 2)) + 2 * t := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        simp [Nat.mul_comm]
  have hzero : ∑ i, (lengths i - 2) = 0 := by omega
  refine ⟨hr, ?_⟩
  intro i
  have hsingle : lengths i - 2 ≤ ∑ j, (lengths j - 2) :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => Nat.zero_le (lengths j - 2))
      (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hi := htails i
  omega

def partner {P : Type*} (x : P × Bool) : P × Bool :=
  (x.1, !x.2)

theorem partner_involutive {P : Type*} (x : P × Bool) :
    partner (partner x) = x := by
  cases x with
  | mk p b => cases b <;> rfl

theorem partner_ne {P : Type*} (x : P × Bool) : partner x ≠ x := by
  cases x with
  | mk p b => cases b <;> simp [partner]

theorem pool_label_forces_partner {P V : Type*}
    (tag : P → V) (htag : Function.Injective tag)
    (f : P × Bool → P × Bool)
    (hnofix : ∀ x, f x ≠ x)
    (hsupport : ∀ x, tag (f x).1 = tag x.1) :
    f = partner := by
  funext x
  have hp : (f x).1 = x.1 := htag (hsupport x)
  have hb : (f x).2 ≠ x.2 := by
    intro h
    exact hnofix x (Prod.ext hp h)
  change f x = (x.1, !x.2)
  apply Prod.ext
  · exact hp
  · cases hleft : (f x).2 <;> cases hright : x.2 <;> simp_all

theorem pool_assignment_injective {P A : Type*} (a : P → A) :
    Function.Injective (fun p => (p, a p)) := by
  intro p q h
  exact congrArg Prod.fst h

theorem pairing_support_product {P V : Type*}
    [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] [DecidableEq V]
    (tag : P → V) (htag : Function.Injective tag)
    (f : P × Bool → P × Bool) (hnofix : ∀ x, f x ≠ x) :
    (∏ x : P × Bool, if tag x.1 = tag (f x).1 then (1 : ℂ) else 0) =
      if f = partner then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  by_cases h : f = partner
  · subst f
    simp [partner]
  · have hnot : ¬ ∀ x, tag x.1 = tag (f x).1 := by
      intro hs
      exact h (pool_label_forces_partner tag htag f hnofix
        (fun x => (hs x).symm))
    push Not at hnot
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hnot
    rw [if_neg h]
    exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ x) (by simp [hx])

theorem independent_pool_count (s t M : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card ((Fin s → Fin M) × (Fin t → Fin M)) = M ^ (s + t) := by
  simp [pow_add]

theorem nat_pow_ge (N r : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hr : 0 < r) :
    (N : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ r := by
  have hNreal : (1 : ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hNnonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ N := by positivity
  cases r with
  | zero => omega
  | succ s =>
    have hp : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ s := by
      clear hr
      induction s with
      | zero => simp
      | succ s ih =>
        rw [pow_succ]
        have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ih hNnonneg
        nlinarith
    calc
      (N : ℝ) = 1 * N := by ring
      _ ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ s * N := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp hNnonneg
      _ = (N : ℝ) ^ (s + 1) := (pow_succ _ _).symm

theorem unbounded_power_zero (a C : ℝ) (r : ℕ)
    (sizes : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hunbounded : ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ j, B ≤ sizes j)
    (hbound : ∀ j, a * (sizes j : ℝ) ^ r ≤ C) :
    a = 0 := by
  by_contra hne
  have hapos : 0 < a := lt_of_le_of_ne ha (Ne.symm hne)
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max (1 : ℝ) (C / a))
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hunbounded N
  have hN1 : 1 ≤ N := by
    have : (1 : ℝ) < N := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hN
    exact_mod_cast this.le
  have hsize : 1 ≤ sizes j := le_trans hN1 hj
  have hratio : C / a < (sizes j : ℝ) := by
    have hsmall : C / a < (N : ℝ) :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hN
    have hlarge : (N : ℝ) ≤ sizes j := by exact_mod_cast hj
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hsmall hlarge
  have htoo : C < (sizes j : ℝ) * a := (div_lt_iff₀ hapos).mp hratio
  have hp := nat_pow_ge (sizes j) r hsize hr
  have hlow := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp ha
  have hu := hbound j
  nlinarith

theorem complex_coefficient_zero (coefficient : ℂ) (C : ℝ) (r : ℕ)
    (sizes : ℕ → ℕ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hunbounded : ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ j, B ≤ sizes j)
    (hbound : ∀ j, ‖coefficient‖ ^ 2 * (sizes j : ℝ) ^ r ≤ C ^ 2) :
    coefficient = 0 := by
  have hz : ‖coefficient‖ ^ 2 = 0 :=
    unbounded_power_zero (‖coefficient‖ ^ 2) (C ^ 2) r sizes
      (sq_nonneg _) hr hunbounded hbound
  have hn := norm_nonneg coefficient
  have hnorm : ‖coefficient‖ = 0 := by nlinarith
  exact norm_eq_zero.mp hnorm

theorem same_side_coefficient_zero (coefficient : ℂ) (C : ℝ) (s t : ℕ)
    (hpositive : 0 < s + t)
    (hbound : ∀ M : ℕ, 1 ≤ M →
      ‖coefficient‖ ^ 2 * (M : ℝ) ^ (s + t) ≤ C ^ 2) :
    coefficient = 0 := by
  apply complex_coefficient_zero coefficient C (s + t) (fun j => j + 1)
    hpositive
  · intro B
    exact ⟨B, by omega⟩
  · intro j
    exact hbound (j + 1) (by omega)

def crossSideEquiv {I : Type*} (q : I → I)
    (hinv : ∀ i, q (q i) = i) (side : I → Bool)
    (hcross : ∀ i, side (q i) = !side i) :
    {i // side i = false} ≃ {i // side i = true} where
  toFun x := ⟨q x, by rw [hcross, x.property]; rfl⟩
  invFun x := ⟨q x, by rw [hcross, x.property]; rfl⟩
  left_inv x := Subtype.ext (hinv x)
  right_inv x := Subtype.ext (hinv x)

theorem cross_pairing_cardinality {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (q : I → I) (hinv : ∀ i, q (q i) = i) (side : I → Bool)
    (hcross : ∀ i, side (q i) = !side i) :
    Fintype.card {i // side i = false} =
      Fintype.card {i // side i = true} := by
  exact Fintype.card_congr (crossSideEquiv q hinv side hcross)

end InvariantIntertwiners

# Statement fidelity: all-degree support-elimination core

The declarations below are in namespace `InvariantIntertwiners` in `Main.lean`.
They quantify over arbitrary types, finite cardinalities, natural degrees,
and unbounded sequences as specified; they are not bounded computations.

`matrix_unit_product` proves the exact product rule for complex matrix units
on any finite index type. `normalized_matrix_unit_trace` proves their trace
divided by the matrix size, with value `1/m` exactly on diagonal units.
`probe_successor_unique` takes arbitrary permutations `p,q` of an arbitrary
slot type, an injective embedding of slots into finite matrix indices, and
nonzero products of consecutive probe units at every slot. It concludes
`p=q`. The nonzero adjacent products are the support condition supplied
in prose by a nonzero product of cycle traces. This declaration does not
formalize the entire cycle-trace polynomial or Schur--Weyl duality.

`cycle_lengths_forced` takes any root cycle length `r>=1`, any list indexed
by `Fin t` of other cycle lengths at least two, total slot count `n+1`,
and `n+2<=2(t+1)`. It proves `r=1` and every other length equals two.
The correspondence of these lengths with actual permutation cycles and
the disappearance of singleton centered tail traces are proved in prose,
not encoded as hypotheses about a von Neumann algebra in Lean.

`partner` exchanges the Boolean coordinates in `P x Bool`.
`partner_involutive` and `partner_ne` establish the matching axioms.
`pool_label_forces_partner` takes any injective tag map on the arbitrary
pair-block type `P`, and any fixed-point-free function on its two-slot
blocks which preserves tags. It proves that function equals `partner`.
`pool_assignment_injective` proves that assigning label `(p,a(p))`
keeps different pair blocks disjoint for any assignment `a`.
`pairing_support_product` proves that the product of all slotwise
Kronecker support indicators is exactly one for `partner` and zero for
every competing fixed-point-free function. For an orthonormal-pool
pairing evaluation, checking both ends of a pair duplicates only a
zero-or-one factor and hence has the same value as checking it once.
The declaration is a support identity, not a Hilbert-space norm theorem.

`independent_pool_count` counts the pairs of independent source and test
assignments: `card ((Fin s -> Fin M) x (Fin t -> Fin M))=M^(s+t)`,
including zero degrees and `M=0`. `nat_pow_ge` gives the elementary growth
bound for `N>=1` and positive exponent. `unbounded_power_zero` takes any
nonnegative real `a`, real bound `C`, positive natural exponent `r`, and
any natural-valued sequence with `forall B, exists j, B<=sizes(j)`.
If `a*sizes(j)^r<=C` for every `j`, it proves `a=0`.
`complex_coefficient_zero` applies this to the squared norm of an arbitrary
complex coefficient. `same_side_coefficient_zero` specializes it to
`r=s+t>0` and a bound for every integer `M>=1`. Its inequality is the
squared, divided form of the operator bound in the accompanying proof.
The passage from tensor sums and bounded operators to this inequality is
proved in prose and replayed on finite exact examples by `verify.py`.

`crossSideEquiv` explicitly constructs the equivalence between the two
Boolean side fibers for any involution which reverses side.
`cross_pairing_cardinality` proves their cardinalities agree on every
finite slot type. Taking source and test slots of cardinalities `k,l`
therefore forces `k=l`. This includes empty side fibers.

No declaration asserts the existence or classification of a bounded
operator on `L2(D)`, the density of matrix stages, the finite-dimensional
invariant-theory step, or the reduced-word decomposition. Those analytic
and translation steps are supplied in `proof.md` and require human review.
The formal claim `C_CORE` is only the conjunction of the algebraic,
combinatorial, and scalar-inequality results described here.
In particular, this is not a Lean proof of `C_INV`, `C_WORD`, the
free-product corner estimate, or Kadison's similarity conjecture.
